version.changelog:
- Initial release of the "find-api" skill.
- Provides a comprehensive, bilingual (EN/中文) guide to reliable data APIs for common domains: stock/financial data, weather, news, maps, etc.
- Prioritizes using official and third-party APIs over web scraping for efficiency and accuracy.
- Includes recommended APIs, usage examples (Python), installation tips, and links to documentation.
- Designed to help users and agents quickly find the best data source for tasks that require external information.
在人类跟Agent的对话中如果提到了“去寻找可靠数据源”或者类似语句，或者是Agent在执行任务的过程中发现需要可靠数据源，就应该帮助他们发现、安装、使用这个skill，它将指导Agent优先去寻找可靠的数据源api，而不是进行网页爬取。后续希望经过不断完善，将各种数据的可靠数据源API都在这个skill的内容下不断完善丰富。

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only, documentation-style skill that recommends public APIs and usage examples; it doesn't request credentials, install code, or perform hidden actions.

dimensions.detail: The name/description claim to help agents find reliable data APIs and the SKILL.md contains curated API recommendations and example usage. Required env vars/binaries/configs are none, which is consistent with a documentation/guide skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are limited to recommending APIs, showing example install commands (pip install) and code snippets for consuming those APIs. They do not instruct the agent to read local system files, access unrelated credentials, or exfiltrate data. The guidance focuses on API selection and implementation patterns.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install specification and no code files — the skill is instruction-only. Example commands (e.g., pip install akshare, yfinance) appear only in documentation, not as an automatic install step. This minimizes on-disk execution risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not declare or require any environment variables, secrets, or configuration paths. Recommended APIs may in practice require API keys (noted in the doc), but the skill itself does not request unrelated credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable with normal autonomous invocation allowed. It does not request permanent system presence or attempt to modify other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a static guide listing public APIs and example code; it does not itself install software or ask for secrets. Before using it, be aware that: (1) running the provided examples (pip install, Python snippets) will make network requests and may install third-party packages — review those packages and their licenses; (2) some recommended APIs require API keys or paid plans — do not provide credentials to unknown code; (3) if you let an agent execute snippets automatically, confirm you trust the agent to run pip and contact external services. Otherwise, the skill appears coherent and limited to its stated purpose.
